standard.summary: 自备的 ArcFace 或其它 embedding 模型的 .onnx 路径。本程序不附带权重、也不自动下载，许可由你自行遵守。
standard.effect: 外观一致性检查与相似度打分都从这里加载特征提取器。开关打开却留空时提交会被拒绝，而不是静默跳过整段检查。
standard.whenToUse: 要开 likeness 打分或外观一致性检查时必填。
standard.avoidWhen: 不打算用这两个功能时留空——路径填错会在训练准备期才炸，白等一次 DataLoader 构建。

standard_en.summary: Path to your own ArcFace (or other embedding) .onnx model. No weights are bundled and nothing is downloaded automatically; the licence is yours to honour.
standard_en.effect: Both the look-consistency check and similarity scoring load their feature extractor from here. With the check on and this empty, submission is rejected rather than the whole check being silently skipped.
standard_en.whenToUse: Required when enabling likeness scoring or the look-consistency check.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Leave it empty if you are not using either feature -- a wrong path only blows up during training preparation, wasting a DataLoader build.

advanced.principle: lulynx_embedder.settings 把 likeness_arcface_model_path 与 likeness_model_path 一起读进 settings，backend=arcface 时优先用前者；base.py 的 arcface stub 在没有权重时直接抛错，而不是返回零向量。
advanced.intervention: 训练准备期的数据集打分阶段，与主训练图无关。
advanced.expectedImpact: 打分本身要遍历全部图片，会延后第一步；用 CPU 时更明显。
advanced.tradeoffs: ONNX 只做前向推理，不参与反传；不要把它和训练用 LoRA / 底模路径混为一谈。

advanced_en.principle: lulynx_embedder.settings reads likeness_arcface_model_path alongside likeness_model_path into the settings object, preferring the former when backend=arcface; the arcface stub in base.py raises instead of returning zero vectors when no weights are configured.
advanced_en.intervention: The dataset scoring stage of training preparation; unrelated to the main training graph.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Scoring itself walks every image and delays the first step, more so on CPU.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: ONNX is used for forward inference only and takes no part in backprop; do not confuse it with a training LoRA or base-model path.
